TIL The United States Tomb of the Unknown Soldier has been continuously guarded 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, without interruption since July 2, 1937.

TIL during the siege of Leningrad, while hundreds of thousands died of starvation, the first seed bank (containing rice, flour, nuts, fruits, vegetables, and 200,000 seeds and plants) was right below the city. The scientists guarding it ate none of it; nine dying of starvation.
TIL Hitler sent his official photographer to secretly photograph Stalin earlobes to determine his ancestry

TIL that The Nutcracker in 3D is the worst-rated Christmas movie on Rotten Tomatoes with a score of 0%. Roger Ebert described it a "wretched" and warned that it "may send children screaming under their seats." It was a box-office bomb, grossing $20 million against a $90 million budget.

TIL when Calvin Coolidge was sworn in by his father at their family farmhouse in Vermont in 1923, he did not place his hand on a Bible. Although a family Bible was on the table, he did not use it, reflecting a New England Puritan tradition against swearing in on scripture.

TIL Leopold II of Belgium had an illegitimate son born with a deformed hand. This led to a cartoon depicting Leopold holding the child, surrounded by the corpses of Congolese who had their hands cut off, with a caption reading "Vengeance from on high".
TIL that Marshall University turns off their memorial fountain on Nov 14th every year until spring. This is to honor their 1970 football team that was killed in a plane crash returning from a game

TIL that in 2012, trading firm Knight Capital lost over $460 million in just 45 minutes after a software deployment error caused its computers to execute millions of unintended stock trades. Its systems had generated 97 warning emails before the market even opened.

TIL that the Vietnamese Emperor Tự Đức had built a giant tomb for when he would die, but he turned out to love this tomb so much that he moved there to live. In the end, he was buried in another place.
TIL it is illegal to wave the Ethiopian flag without the emblem. flying the plain green, yellow, red banner could get you a fine of 5000 birr or rigorous imprisonment up to one year and six months.
